gloss: prayer for passing an exam; wish for exam success

definitions.gloss: prayer for passing an exam; wish for exam success
definitions.explanation: A prayer or wish offered at a shrine or temple to pass an entrance exam or certification test. Expressed through visiting shrines, buying good-luck charms, or writing on votive tablets.

examples.japanese: {合格祈願|ごうかくきがん}のお{守|まも}りをもらった。
examples.english: I received a good-luck charm for passing exams.

examples.japanese: {受験|じゅけん}{前日|ぜんじつ}に{合格祈願|ごうかくきがん}に{神社|じんじゃ}へ{行|い}った。
examples.english: The day before the exam, I went to a shrine to pray for success.

examples.japanese: {合格祈願|ごうかくきがん}の{絵馬|えま}に{志望校|しぼうこう}の{名前|なまえ}を{書|か}いて{奉納|ほうのう}した。
examples.english: I wrote the name of the school I hoped to attend on a votive tablet for exam success and dedicated it.

notes:
Combines {合格|ごうかく} (passing, success) + {祈願|きがん} (prayer, supplication). A very common ritual for Japanese students, especially those taking university entrance exams.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {合格祈願|ごうかくきがん}のお{守|まも}り: good-luck charm for exam success
- {合格祈願|ごうかくきがん}に{参拝|さんぱい}する: to visit a shrine to pray for success
- {合格祈願|ごうかくきがん}の{絵馬|えま}: votive tablet wishing for exam success

CULTURAL NOTE:
Shrines dedicated to Tenjin ({天神|てんじん}), the deified scholar {菅原道真|すがわらのみちざね}, are popular destinations for students seeking blessings before exams.
